method: All 261 local source images visually inspected; selected front images checked individually for topology. Alpha bounds use actual decoded local pixels. Complex symmetry counts additionally checked with angular alpha profiles.
ellipseConvention: cx/cy/rx/ry relative to full decoded source image; image y-down. rimEllipse and faceEllipse both enclose the complete front face including its outer lip. They do not describe the inner spoke-root region. rotationDeg=0; oblique ellipses are visual axis-aligned approximations.
accuracy: Visual photo-derived reconstruction references only; exact dimensional/CAD accuracy is not asserted.
